# SMI device-completeness audit

Status: complete but unpruned first-pass audit. These artifacts have not yet been used to drive
runtime logging or baseline changes; they are preserved as the raw reconciliation basis for that
later work.

Reconciles the PVs **shown on the 12ID CS-Studio/Phoebus screens** against the PVs **modelled by
the bluesky profile** (`smi_beamline` devices) and the subset **captured in the per-scan
baseline** (`sd.baseline`).

## Artifacts (regenerated by the tool)

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `audit_report.html` | Interactive, filterable table (by text / category / subsystem) + summary counts. Start here. |
| `audit_master.csv` | One row per PV **record** with all flags/category/subsystem (machine-friendly). |
| `audit_gaps.md` | Narrative summary: totals, per-subsystem gaps, the capture-candidate list, unresolved CSS PVs. |
| `profile_skipped.txt` | Profile instances the enumerator could not harvest (logical/non-EPICS wrappers, suspenders, attenuator banks). |

## Categories

- **`css_only`** — shown on a screen but the profile does not model it (a gap).
- **`profile_not_baseline`** — on a screen *and* modelled, but not in baseline (lowest-effort capture candidates).
- **`covered`** — on a screen + modelled + baselined.
- **`baseline_not_css`** — captured in baseline but not on any audited screen.
- **`profile_only`** — modelled but neither screened nor baselined.

Comparison is at **record** level (the PV with any trailing `.FIELD` removed); the CSS fields seen
(`.RBV`, `.VAL`, …) are listed per record.

## Hard rule: NO EPICS connections

The profile side is enumerated entirely from **fake devices** (`ophyd.sim.make_fake_device`) plus
static AST parsing of `startup/smibase/*.py`. PV names are composed with ophyd's own
`Component.maybe_add_prefix` on the fake instances — zero channel access. Verified with `strace`
(no traffic to CA ports 5064/5065, no non-local connects).

## Scope

The resolver follows the include/link graph rooted at `12id/main.bob` + `12id/main.opi`, confined
to `12id/`, `12id1/` and the shared `common/` templates (so it does not wander into the
accelerator/other beamlines/vendor menus via navigation). Undulator / front-end / EPS PVs that are
placed directly on the 12ID screens are still captured. Phoebus `.bob` supersedes `.opi` when both
exist for a screen.

## Regenerate

Run in the profile's pixi env (so `ophyd` + the `smi_beamline` classes import). No EPICS, no
network:

```bash
PROF=/nsls2/data1/smi/shared/config/bluesky/profile_collection
PY=$PROF/.pixi/envs/test/bin/python
cd ~/git/smi/smi-plans
PYTHONPATH=src:$PROF/src EPICS_CA_AUTO_ADDR_LIST=NO EPICS_CA_ADDR_LIST=127.0.0.1 \
  "$PY" -m smi_plans.audit \
    --css ~/git/cs-studio-xf \
    --profile "$PROF" \
    --out docs/device_audit
```

Tooling lives in `smi_plans/audit/` (`css_resolver`, `profile_pvs`, `reconcile`, `report`,
`__main__`); unit tests in `tests/test_audit.py`.

## Known limitations (first pass)

- Detector area-detector deep **vendor** subscreens (ADCore/ADet) are not traversed (they explode
  combinatorially and are largely generic AD plugin PVs); the 12ID `det/` screens' own PVs and the
  profile's detector devices are covered.
- ~400 CSS PVs remain **unresolved** (macros supplied only at runtime, e.g. PMAC motor-detail
  popups). They are listed in `audit_gaps.md` rather than dropped.
- A handful of profile instances are skipped (see `profile_skipped.txt`): logical/non-EPICS
  devices (`beam`, `SMI`), suspenders, `ring` (computed prefix), and the attenuator-set banks
  (the individual `att1_*`/`att2_*` attenuators are covered).
